title: Home-Site Lease Agreement: Renewal of a Fixed Term and Holdover
content:
**Article — renewal of the Home-Site Lease**

1. Renewal applies only to a fixed term (twelve months or twenty-four months); a month-to-month lease runs on without renewal and changes rent only under the month-to-month rent-increase terms.
2. A renewal is offered or signed only while the lease is active, as the lease record shows.
3. *Retired — this clause is no longer in force:* the former clause by which the offer is issued the lot class's offer lead days before the current term end date, with one offer for each term the lot class makes available, each starting the day after the current term end date. It has been superseded by the current basis for issuing renewal offers.
4. The twelve-month-equivalent rent is the current monthly site rent, plus the lot class's twenty-four-month reduction when the current term is a twenty-four-month term.
5. *Retired — this clause is no longer in force:* the former clause pricing the twelve-month offer as the twelve-month-equivalent rent raised by the lot class's twelve-month renewal increase rate, the twenty-four-month offer as that equivalent raised by the twenty-four-month rate less the twenty-four-month reduction, and the month-to-month offer as the twelve-month offer plus the month-to-month premium, each rounded half up to the cent. It has been superseded by the current basis for pricing renewal offers.
6. A renewal election is accepted only when the resident signs it no later than the response deadline, which falls the lot class's response days after the renewal offer date. The response window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the offer date, and the deadline day itself is still in time. The offer date and the deadline are those recorded on the renewal offer among the lease's notices.
7. Signing is the resident's own act; the resident desk records the election and the resident signs it.
8. When the current term ends with no renewal signed, the lot class's holdover basis applies on the day after the term end date: conversion to month to month converts the lease to month to month at the month-to-month offer, and automatic twelve-month renewal renews it for twelve months at the twelve-month offer.
9. A lease with a notice to vacate pending, or in default, is not renewed and does not hold over; it ends under the notice or the default process.

**Clause 6 at its boundary (hypothetical; offer delivered on day D, response days 45)**

| Signing day | Election |
|---|---|
| D plus 44 days | accepted |
| D plus 45 days (the deadline) | accepted |
| D plus 46 days | not accepted |

**Clause 4 illustrated (hypothetical)** — a current twenty-four-month term at 700.00 on a lot class whose twenty-four-month reduction is 16.00 has a twelve-month-equivalent rent of 716.00; a current twelve-month term at 700.00 has a twelve-month-equivalent rent of 700.00.

**Clauses 1, 2, 8 and 9 by lease status and term**

| Lease | Renewal | At the end of the term with nothing signed |
|---|---|---|
| active, fixed term | may be offered and signed | holdover basis applies the next day |
| active, month to month | none | runs on |
| notice to vacate pending | not renewed | no holdover; ends under the notice |
| in default | not renewed | no holdover; ends under the default process |

superseded_clauses: The twelve-month offer is that equivalent raised by renewal_increase_pct_twelve_month percent; the twenty-four-month offer is the equivalent raised by renewal_increase_pct_twenty_four_month percent less twenty_four_month_rent_discount_monthly; the month-to-month offer is the twelve-month offer plus month_to_month_premium_monthly; each is rounded half up to the cent.

The offer is issued renewal_offer_lead_days calendar days before the current term end date, with one offer row for each term the lot class makes available, each starting the day after the current term end date.
